speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a neonate presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth; to determine the cause, I need to ask your mother a few questions about your birth history and current symptoms. Did your mother have any recent fevers, urinary tract infections, or known infections like Zika or Listeria during pregnancy or the delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis secondary to Chorioamnionitis, presenting with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy and seizures.
